verdict.rationale: The evidence covers team collaboration: shared live previews, roles mapped from GitHub merge authority, and creating tasks from Slack, Linear or Jira. Nothing documents an engineering lead creating or launching agent sessions on behalf of other users, or any impersonation or delegated-ownership capability. Adjacent team features do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create agent sessions on behalf of other users in my organization
